subject: Follow-up: No-training commitment, subprocessor evidence, and prompt/output ownership
messages:
From: Evelyn Ross <evelyn.ross@medilinkhealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@medilinkhealth.com
Date: 2026-08-22T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up: No-train commitment & evidence for DPA

Hi Mina,

Thanks for the demo last week — Medilink's procurement and privacy teams asked me to follow up with a short list of items we need to close the procurement review:

- A written "no-training" commitment for customer content when using Redwood hosted inference (we need specific scope and exclusions).
- A packet with evidence: current subprocessor roster, access logs / credentialing summary, and the latest SOC 2 report (redacted if necessary).
- Clarification on prompt/response ownership: we need to understand whether outputs (generated clinical summaries in our workload) are owned exclusively by Medilink or if Redwood asserts any rights.
- Data residency and cross-border transfer controls (Medilink is US-based but some vendors are EU).

Can you point me to a signed amendment sample or evidence bundle we can include in our contract packet? Procurement would like a target of end-of-week for initial review.

I attached our procurement checklist for reference.

Thanks,
Evelyn
Evelyn Ross
Sr. Manager, Vendor Risk
Medilink Health

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evelyn Ross <evelyn.ross@medilinkhealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-22T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: No-training commitment & evidence for DPA

Hi Evelyn — thanks for the clear list and the checklist (received). Quick summary of what we can provide immediately and what we'll need legal sign-off on:

What we can provide now (attached):
- Draft "No-Training Amendment" (no_train_amendment_draft.pdf) — legal-approved language suitable for hosted API use; includes definition of customer content and scoped exclusions for telemetry used for service stability (see Section 2).
- Current subprocessor export (CSV) and a short readme explaining roles (subprocessors_2026-08.csv, evidence_packet_readme.txt).
- SOC 2 report link & redaction process (we host the report; legal will share the redacted copy once we confirm the NDA).

Clarifications:
- No-training: For hosted customers who sign the no-training amendment, Redwood will not use customer-provided prompt/response data to train or finetune publicly-shared model weights. We do collect aggregated telemetry for system health and to detect abuse; that telemetry is not used to improve the customer's own model outputs.
- Prompt/response ownership: By default customers retain output ownership; we will include explicit language in the amendment that grants Medilink ownership of generated outputs (subject to the DPA/IP clause you sign).
- Cross-border transfers: we can restrict processing to US regions for production workloads; we also offer Dedicated or Private deployment options for data residency or PHI requirements.

Next steps I propose:
1) Rishi (legal) to confirm final amendment language and produce a DocuSign link.
2) Karthik (privacy) to provide a short note about retention windows and access controls.
3) If Medilink needs a hardened evidence package (logs/access traces), we can schedule a short audit call.

Timeline: we can get the redacted SOC2 and DocuSign amendment to you by EOD Thursday if that aligns with procurement.

Attaching: Medilink_Procurement_Checklist.pdf, no_train_amendment_draft.pdf, subprocessors_2026-08.csv, evidence_packet_readme.txt

Thanks — I looped in Rishi and Karthik for the legal/privacy confirmations.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Technical Program Manager, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evelyn Ross <evelyn.ross@medilinkhealth.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-22T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: No-training commitment & evidence for DPA

Evelyn — thanks, and apologies for the delay. I reviewed Mina's draft and added a few clarifications that procurement typically asks for. High-level points:

1) Definition & scope of "no-training":
   - "Customer Content" is defined as data submitted by Medilink via API or uploaded into a dedicated instance; excludes aggregated telemetry and anonymized infrastructure metrics.
   - Redwood will not use Customer Content to train, finetune, or improve any models that are made available to other customers or the public.
   - We reserve the right to use aggregated, de-identified telemetry to improve platform stability; we will not re-identify or surface Customer Content for training.

2) Evidence & attestations:
   - Attached: subprocessors_2026-08.csv (roles and locations).
   - We can provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II report under an NDA; our compliance portal link is in the Drive folder.
   - For audit-grade evidence (access logs, key rotation records) we can provide summaries quarterly or for a defined lookback period; full raw logs require a scoped eDiscovery/forensic request.

3) Prompt/response ownership and IP:
   - We will include explicit language confirming that Medilink retains ownership of prompts and generated outputs. Redwood asserts no ownership rights over customer outputs.
   - We recommend also adding an indemnity carve-out for outputs that contain third-party copyrighted material supplied by customers (standard procurement ask).

4) Deployment and PHI:
   - If Medilink plans to process PHI, we recommend Dedicated or Private deployment and an updated DPA that references BAAs where applicable.

Action items we propose for contracting: 
- I will finalize the amendment language and send a DocuSign envelope (link below) for signature.
- If Procurement wants quarterly evidence deliverables, confirm desired cadence and scope; we can include a section in the SOW.

DocuSign (amendment draft): https://app.docusign.com/prepare/EXAMPLE-DOCUSIGN-AMENDMENT-4782
Drive evidence folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-example-evidence

Attachments: subprocessors_2026-08.csv, evidence_packet_readme.txt

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Sr. Counsel, Privacy & Security
Redwood Inference

From: Evelyn Ross <evelyn.ross@medilinkhealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@medilinkhealth.com
Date: 2026-08-22T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: No-training commitment & evidence for DPA

Rishi / Mina — this is helpful, thank you. A couple of follow-ups from procurement/privacy: 

- Can Redwood commit to a quarterly evidence package that includes (1) the subprocessor roster, (2) a short redacted access-log summary for the prior quarter, and (3) confirmation that no training activity occurred on Medilink data? That confirmation can be a signed statement from legal for now.
- For prompt/response ownership: confirmation in the amendment is fine. We also want to reserve the right to request an export of our training/exchange history on 30 days' notice. Is that possible?
- Timeline: if you can get the DocuSign by Thursday EOD and the redacted SOC2 by Friday, procurement will begin review next week.

Looking forward to the DocuSign link and the signed confirmation language. If it helps, we can do a 20-minute call tomorrow to align.

Thanks,
Evelyn

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evelyn Ross <evelyn.ross@medilinkhealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-22T16:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: No-training commitment & evidence for DPA

Evelyn — appreciate the quick confirmation. Short answers: 

- Quarterly evidence package: yes, Redwood can provide a packaged quarterly evidence export (subprocessor roster + redacted access summary + signed legal attestation that no training occurred on customer content) — we'll include the cadence in the SOW.
- Export of exchange history: we can provide an export of customer-submitted prompts and responses (or a secure snapshot) upon request with 30 days' notice; we'll document this in the SOW and DPA.
- DocuSign & SOC2 timing: Rishi is preparing the DocuSign envelope now; we expect to send it by Thursday EOD. The redacted SOC2 will be uploaded to the Drive folder by Friday.

I'll schedule a 20-minute sync for tomorrow afternoon in case Procurement wants to run through the evidence packet live.

Best,
Mina
Senior Technical Program Manager, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
